## TDD Evidence

- [ ] I wrote or updated the failing/behavior test before or with the implementation.
- [ ] New feature behavior has automated tests.
- [ ] Bug fixes include regression tests.
- [ ] API/client contract changes are covered in the owning repo.
- [ ] No tests were removed or weakened without explanation.

## Test Commands

- [ ] `npm run test:obligations`
- [ ] `npm run quality:ci`
- [ ] `npm run quality:strict` for release-candidate changes, or explain existing unrelated debt below.
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` when this change affects browser workflow behavior, or explain why not.

## High-Risk Review

- [ ] Auth/authorization impact reviewed.
- [ ] Attendance/timesheet/payroll source-of-truth impact reviewed.
- [ ] Employee, applicant, payroll, billing, or document data impact reviewed.
- [ ] Deployment, credential, migration, deletion, or irreversible action not included.
